8	/// The chat feature's one port — `features/chat/presentation` depends on
9	/// this abstract class only, never `chat/data` (RNF06). Every method but
10	/// [sendMessage] returns `Future<Either<Failure, T>>` (RNF09); [sendMessage]
11	/// alone returns a `Stream` given the SSE nature of its response
12	/// (Boundaries).
13	abstract class ChatRepository {
14	  /// Calls `chat-sessions-list` (`ApiClient.get`, via
15	  /// `ChatRemoteDataSource`) — works offline via the `chat_sessions` Hive
16	  /// box (Code Map): on [Failure.networkOffline]/[Failure.networkTimeout],
17	  /// falls back to a full dump of that box, same "cache fallback"
18	  /// convention `EntriesRepositoryImpl.list()` already uses for its own
19	  /// first/fresh page. Every other [Failure] propagates as `Left`,
20	  /// unmapped (RNF09).
21	  Future<Either<Failure, List<ChatSession>>> listSessions();
22	
23	  /// Calls `chat-sessions-create` (`ApiClient.post`) with no title
24	  /// (Boundaries: "`chat-sessions-create` with no title") — blocked
25	  /// offline per `requirements.md` ("`POST /chat/sessions` — blocked
26	  /// offline"), so unlike [listSessions] there is no cache fallback here:
27	  /// every [Failure], including [Failure.networkOffline], is returned as
28	  /// `Left`, unmapped. On success, persists the new session to the
29	  /// `chat_sessions` Hive box before returning `Right`, same
30	  /// "persist then return" ordering [listSessions] already uses.
31	  Future<Either<Failure, ChatSession>> createSession();
32	
33	  /// Calls `chat-messages-list` (`ApiClient.get`, [sessionId] appended as
34	  /// the one trailing path segment) — works offline via the
35	  /// `chat_messages` Hive box, same cache-fallback convention
36	  /// [listSessions] already uses, filtered to [sessionId] and sorted by
37	  /// `seq` ascending (the backend's own "ordered by seq", `openapi.yaml`).
38	  Future<Either<Failure, List<ChatMessage>>> listMessages(String sessionId);
39	
40	  /// Calls `chat-messages-send` (`ApiClient.postStream`, [sessionId]
41	  /// appended as the one trailing path segment) with `{content}` — the
42	  /// one streaming exception to this port's otherwise all-`Future` shape
43	  /// (Boundaries/RNF09: "every other method returns
44	  /// `Future<Either<Failure, T>>`"). No connectivity resolves immediately
45	  /// to a single `Left(Failure.networkOffline)` emission, never queued
46	  /// (Boundaries) — `ApiClient.postStream`'s own first awaited `Dio.post`
47	  /// call surfaces that failure before any byte streams. A connection that
48	  /// closes without a `done`/`error` SSE event is surfaced as a single
49	  /// trailing `Left(Failure.networkTimeout)` (Design Notes: "the taxonomy
50	  /// has no dedicated 'dropped stream' code"). No local write queue, no
51	  /// Hive persistence of sent messages (Design Notes: chat holds no local
52	  /// write queue for this story).
53	  Stream<Either<Failure, ChatStreamEvent>> sendMessage(
54	    String sessionId,
55	    String content,
56	  );
57	}

13	/// slot — never the tap-to-retry copy, Boundaries: "generic error
14	/// indicator (not retry copy)" — Story 6.3's job), `complete` (plain
15	/// text, nothing else). [ChatUiMessage.content] itself is rendered as-is
16	/// in every state — never cleared on failure (I/O matrix).
17	class ChatBubble extends StatefulWidget {
18	  const ChatBubble({required this.message, super.key});
19	
20	  final ChatUiMessage message;
21	
22	  @override
23	  State<ChatBubble> createState() => _ChatBubbleState();
24	}
25	
26	class _ChatBubbleState extends State<ChatBubble>
27	    with SingleTickerProviderStateMixin {
28	  late final AnimationController _cursorController;
29	
30	  @override
31	  void initState() {
32	    super.initState();
33	    _cursorController = AnimationController(
34	      vsync: this,
35	      duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 600),
36	    );
37	    _syncCursorAnimation();
38	  }
39	
40	  @override
41	  void didUpdateWidget(ChatBubble oldWidget) {
42	    super.didUpdateWidget(oldWidget);
43	    _syncCursorAnimation();
44	  }
45	
46	  /// Keeps the ticker running only while actually needed — a message
47	  /// that finalizes to `complete`/`failed` must stop ticking forever
48	  /// after, both so a long-lived chat session never leaks one live
49	  /// `AnimationController` per past message, and so nothing waiting on
50	  /// "every animation in the tree has settled" (e.g. a test's own
51	  /// `pumpAndSettle()`) ever blocks on a bubble that finished streaming.
52	  void _syncCursorAnimation() {
53	    final shouldAnimate = widget.message.status == ChatMessageStatus.streaming;
54	    if (shouldAnimate && !_cursorController.isAnimating) {
55	      _cursorController.repeat(reverse: true);
56	    } else if (!shouldAnimate && _cursorController.isAnimating) {
57	      _cursorController.stop();
58	    }
59	  }
60	
61	  @override
62	  void dispose() {
63	    _cursorController.dispose();
64	    super.dispose();
65	  }
66	
67	  @override
68	  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
69	    final message = widget.message;
70	    final isUser = message.role == ChatMessageRole.user;
71	    // Boundaries: "cursor skipped under
72	    // `MediaQuery.of(context).disableAnimations`" — the real token text
73	    // itself always reveals as real tokens actually arrive (there is no
74	    // separate typing-speed animation to collapse here), only the
75	    // blinking-cursor glyph is conditional on Reduce Motion.
76	    final reduceMotion = MediaQuery.of(context).disableAnimations;
77	    final showCursor =
78	        message.status == ChatMessageStatus.streaming && !reduceMotion;
79	
80	    return Align(
81	      alignment: isUser ? Alignment.centerRight : Alignment.centerLeft,
82	      child: Container(
83	        margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: DesignTokens.chatBubbleGap),
84	        constraints: BoxConstraints(
85	          maxWidth:
86	              MediaQuery.of(context).size.width *
87	              DesignTokens.chatBubbleMaxWidthFraction,
88	        ),
89	        padding: DesignTokens.chatBubblePadding,
90	        decoration: BoxDecoration(
91	          color: isUser
92	              ? DesignTokens.colorChatBubbleUser
93	              : DesignTokens.colorSurfaceElevated,
94	          borderRadius: BorderRadius.only(
95	            topLeft: const Radius.circular(DesignTokens.radiusMd),
96	            topRight: const Radius.circular(DesignTokens.radiusMd),
97	            bottomLeft: Radius.circular(isUser ? DesignTokens.radiusMd : 0),
98	            bottomRight: Radius.circular(isUser ? 0 : DesignTokens.radiusMd),
99	          ),
100	          boxShadow: isUser ? null : DesignTokens.elevation1,
101	        ),
102	        child: Column(
103	          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
104	          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
105	          children: [
106	            Text.rich(
107	              TextSpan(
108	                children: [
109	                  TextSpan(text: message.content),
110	                  if (showCursor)
111	                    WidgetSpan(
112	                      alignment: PlaceholderAlignment.middle,
113	                      child: ExcludeSemantics(
114	                        child: FadeTransition(
115	                          opacity: _cursorController,
116	                          child: const Text('▏'),
117	                        ),
118	                      ),
119	                    ),
120	                ],
121	              ),
122	              style: DesignTokens.textBodyLg.copyWith(
123	                color: DesignTokens.colorTextPrimary,
124	              ),
125	            ),
126	            if (message.status == ChatMessageStatus.failed) ...[
127	              const SizedBox(height: DesignTokens.spacingXs),
128	              Container(
129	                padding: DesignTokens.chatFailureIndicatorPadding,
130	                decoration: const BoxDecoration(
131	                  color: DesignTokens.colorErrorBg,
132	                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.all(
133	                    Radius.circular(DesignTokens.radiusSm),
134	                  ),
135	                ),
136	                child: Text(
137	                  'Falha ao gerar resposta',
138	                  style: DesignTokens.textCaptionSm.copyWith(
139	                    color: DesignTokens.colorError,
140	                  ),
141	                ),
142	              ),
143	            ],
144	          ],
145	        ),
146	      ),
147	    );
148	  }

155	  void _navigate(BuildContext context, String location) {
156	    if (_actionTaken) {
157	      return;
158	    }
159	    _actionTaken = true;
160	    Navigator.of(context).pop();
161	    context.go(location);
162	  }

164	  /// I/O matrix: "New session online"/"New session offline" — `await`s
165	  /// `ChatCubit.startNewSession()`'s own `Either` (Boundaries: "a cubit
166	  /// action's result must be observed by its caller") and surfaces any
167	  /// [Failure] (including [Failure.networkOffline]) as a transient
168	  /// `SnackBar`; the drawer closes either way, the current session is
169	  /// left untouched on failure (`ChatCubit`'s own job, not this widget's).
170	  Future<void> _startNewSession(BuildContext context) async {
171	    if (_actionTaken) {
172	      return;
173	    }
174	    _actionTaken = true;
175	    final cubit = context.read<ChatCubit>();
176	    // Captured before `Navigator.pop()` closes this widget's own subtree
177	    // — `ScaffoldMessenger.of(context)` resolves to `ChatScreen`'s own
178	    // `Scaffold` (an ancestor of the drawer, Boundaries), whose messenger
179	    // instance outlives the drawer closing.
180	    final messenger = ScaffoldMessenger.of(context);
181	    final result = await cubit.startNewSession();
182	    if (!mounted || !context.mounted) {
183	      return;
184	    }
185	    Navigator.of(context).pop();
186	    result.match(
187	      (failure) => messenger.showSnackBar(
188	        SnackBar(content: Text(failure.message)),
189	      ),
190	      (_) {},
191	    );
192	  }
193	
194	  /// I/O matrix: "Switch session"/"Switch to already-active session" —
195	  /// same `await` + observe-the-result shape as [_startNewSession].
196	  Future<void> _switchSession(BuildContext context, String sessionId) async {
197	    if (_actionTaken) {
198	      return;
199	    }
200	    _actionTaken = true;
201	    final cubit = context.read<ChatCubit>();
202	    final messenger = ScaffoldMessenger.of(context);
203	    final result = await cubit.switchSession(sessionId);
204	    if (!mounted || !context.mounted) {
205	      return;
206	    }
207	    Navigator.of(context).pop();
208	    result.match(
209	      (failure) => messenger.showSnackBar(
210	        SnackBar(content: Text(failure.message)),
211	      ),
212	      (_) {},
213	    );
214	  }

417	/// `updatedAt`'s local wall-clock time, `HH:mm` — same presentation-only
418	/// parse-for-display convention and `'--:--'` malformed-input fallback as
419	/// `entry_record_card.dart`'s own `_formatTime` (RNF09: never throws).
420	String _formatSessionTimestamp(String updatedAt) {
421	  final local = DateTime.tryParse(updatedAt)?.toLocal();
422	  if (local == null) {
423	    return '--:--';
424	  }
425	  final hour = local.hour.toString().padLeft(2, '0');
426	  final minute = local.minute.toString().padLeft(2, '0');
427	  return '$hour:$minute';
428	}

1	/// A finished microphone recording — the on-disk file [path] plus its
2	/// [durationSeconds], known only once [MicRecorder.stop] returns. Plain
3	/// Dart, not `package:record`'s own types — keeps this port, and every
4	/// caller that depends on it (`AudioEntryCubit`), decoupled from that
5	/// package's shape (Boundaries: "decouple the cubit from both packages").
6	class MicRecording {
7	  const MicRecording({required this.path, required this.durationSeconds});
8	
9	  final String path;
10	  final int durationSeconds;
11	}
12	
13	/// Capture's own mic-recording port — the `record`-backed
14	/// `RecordMicRecorder` is the only implementation (Code Map), mirroring
15	/// `EntriesRepository`'s port convention (an abstract class in `domain/`,
16	/// a concrete `data/` class wrapping the real package, injected via
17	/// `capture_injection.dart`). `AudioEntryCubit` depends on this interface
18	/// only, never on `package:record` directly (RNF06-style boundary,
19	/// extended here to any native package, not just `data/`).
20	abstract class MicRecorder {
21	  /// Checks (and, per `record`'s own `AudioRecorder.hasPermission()`
22	  /// default, requests if not yet granted) microphone permission — the
23	  /// one permission check this story ever performs (Boundaries: "no
24	  /// separate `permission_handler`"). `false` means denied/unavailable.
25	  Future<bool> hasPermission();
26	
27	  /// Starts a new recording session to a fresh temp file. Callers must
28	  /// have already confirmed [hasPermission] returns `true` — this method
29	  /// itself doesn't re-check.
30	  Future<void> start();
31	
32	  /// Stops the current recording session, returning its file path and
33	  /// duration (whole seconds). `null` if no session was in progress.
34	  Future<MicRecording?> stop();
35	
36	  /// Stops and discards (deletes) the current recording session, if any —
37	  /// used only when leaving the Áudio tab mid-recording (I/O matrix:
38	  /// "Recorder stopped/released", resource safety only, never the full
39	  /// Story 3.4 cross-tab cancel choreography).
40	  Future<void> cancel();
41	
42	  /// A normalized (0.0–1.0) amplitude sample roughly every 200ms while a
43	  /// recording session is active — drives the waveform animation. No
44	  /// guaranteed emissions outside an active session.
45	  Stream<double> get amplitudeStream;
46	}

1	/// `chat.messages.list`'s own `role` enum (`openapi.yaml:1188-1192`).
2	enum ChatMessageRole { user, assistant }
3	
4	/// `chat.messages.list`'s own `status` enum (`openapi.yaml:1198-1203`) —
5	/// the exact 3 states RF04's own Acceptance Criteria names
6	/// ("processing/streaming, error, complete"), reused verbatim here rather
7	/// than a second near-duplicate enum: [ChatMessageStatus.failed] is this
8	/// story's "error" state, [ChatMessageStatus.streaming] its
9	/// "processing/streaming" state.
10	enum ChatMessageStatus { streaming, complete, failed }
11	
12	/// A persisted chat message — `chat.messages.list`'s own response `data`
13	/// item (`openapi.yaml:1180-1218`), modeled 1:1. A plain value type, no
14	/// `freezed` (same rationale as [ChatSession]/`Entry`), but with a
15	/// `copyWith` — unlike those two, this entity's [content]/[status] mutate
16	/// repeatedly as a streaming response grows (`ChatCubit`'s own append-only
17	/// message list rebuilds entries of this exact shape on every `token`
18	/// event).
19	class ChatMessage {
20	  const ChatMessage({
21	    required this.id,
22	    required this.sessionId,

Implemented spec-6-3 (Dropped-Stream Resilience & Offline Composer Lock) in full. `fvm flutter analyze` reports zero issues; `fvm flutter test` passes all 954 tests.

## What changed

**New files:**
- `lib/features/chat/domain/services/connectivity_watcher.dart` — `abstract class ConnectivityWatcher { Stream<bool> watch(); }`.
- `lib/features/chat/data/services/connectivity_plus_watcher.dart` — `connectivity_plus`-backed impl; `watch()` emits the current status via `checkConnectivity()` (best-effort, swallows a platform-channel failure) then `onConnectivityChanged`.
- `test/support/fake_connectivity_watcher.dart` — shared controllable fake, reused across every test file that constructs `ChatCubit` directly.

**Core feature wiring:**
- `ChatRepository`/`ChatRepositoryImpl`/`ChatRemoteDataSource` gained `retryMessage(sessionId, userMessageId)`, hitting `chat-messages-retry` with `pathParams: [sessionId, userMessageId]`, `data: const {}`. The data source's SSE buffering/parsing was extracted into a shared `_consumeSse` helper reused by `sendMessage`/`retryMessage`.
- `ChatCubit` constructor now takes `ConnectivityWatcher`, subscribes immediately, tracks `_isOffline`, and emits it onto every fresh `ChatReady` (`_bootstrap`, `switchSession`, `startNewSession`). Added `retryMessage(aiMessageId)`: resets the same failed bubble in place, calls `chat-messages-retry` when the preceding user message's new `ChatUiMessage.serverId` is known, else falls back to a full `sendMessage` resend into the same slot. `sendMessage`/`retryMessage` now share a `_consumeStream` helper; `message_created` is captured onto the matching user bubble's `serverId` via `_applyStreamEvent`.
- `chat_state.dart`: `ChatReady.isOffline` (default `false`) and `ChatUiMessage.serverId` (nullable), both threaded through `copyWith`/`==`/`hashCode`.
- `chat_injection.dart`: registers `Connectivity`/`ConnectivityWatcher` and passes the watcher into `ChatCubit`.
- `retry_interceptor.dart`: added `'chat-messages-retry'` to `neverRetriedFunctions`.

The coordinator sent a message while you were working:
Three parallel review layers (blind-hunter, edge-case-hunter, verification-gap) just reviewed the full diff of your spec-6-3 implementation. After triage, 8 findings need patching now (no spec change, no revert — just fixes). Apply all 8, then re-run `fvm flutter analyze` (expect zero issues) and `fvm flutter test` (expect all passing), and fix anything that breaks. Report back when done.

1. `lib/features/chat/presentation/cubit/chat_cubit.dart` — `sendMessage()`/`retryMessage()` never check `current.isOffline`. The offline lock today is UI-only (`_ChatComposer.canSend`), but a failed bubble's retry tap is a separate affordance not gated by that `canSend` check — a user can tap "tentar novamente" on a past failed bubble while the offline banner is showing and trigger a real network call, contradicting the banner's own "novas mensagens bloqueadas" copy. Add an early-return guard (mirroring the existing `current is! ChatReady`/`_isSending` guards) so neither method proceeds while `current.isOffline` is true.

2. `lib/features/chat/presentation/widgets/chat_bubble.dart` — the failed-bubble's `Semantics(button: true, ...)` is hardcoded regardless of whether the nullable `onRetry` callback was actually supplied. Gate it on `onRetry != null` so a bubble built without a retry callback isn't announced to screen readers as a working button.

3. `lib/features/chat/presentation/cubit/chat_cubit.dart` — `retryMessage()`'s guard checks `messages[aiIndex].status == ChatMessageStatus.failed` but never checks `role == ChatMessageRole.assistant`. Not reachable today (only AI messages ever get `failed` status), but add the role check anyway for defensive correctness, matching this codebase's existing defensive-guard style.

4. `lib/features/chat/presentation/widgets/chat_bubble.dart` — the retry copy string `'Falha ao gerar resposta — toque para tentar novamente'` is duplicated verbatim in both the `Semantics.label` and the `Text` child. Extract it to one shared local constant/variable used by both, so a future copy edit can't desync the spoken label from the visible text.

5. `pubspec.yaml` — `connectivity_plus` was added with no explanatory comment, inconsistent with this file's own convention of commenting every dependency choice (e.g. the existing comment block right above it explaining why `path_provider` must be a direct dependency). Add a short comment explaining why it's there (feature-local `ConnectivityWatcher` impl for story 6.3's offline composer lock).

6. Add a widget-level test (in `test/features/chat/presentation/screens/chat_screen_test.dart` or `test/features/chat/presentation/widgets/chat_bubble_test.dart`, whichever fits your existing structure) exercising the *normal* retry path — a failed AI bubble whose preceding user message has a `serverId` — driven through an actual `ChatBubble` tap inside a mounted `ChatScreen`/widget tree, asserting `chat-messages-retry` ends up called (not the `sendMessage` fallback). Today that path is only covered at the `ChatCubit` unit-test level; the widget-level retry test you wrote only covers the no-`serverId` fallback. (Direct precedent: spec-6-2's own round-1 review treated an identical "AC verified only at the cubit, not the screen, layer" gap as a Patch.)

7. Add a unit test for `lib/features/chat/data/services/connectivity_plus_watcher.dart`'s online/offline mapping, using a mocked/faked `Connectivity` (its constructor already accepts an injectable `Connectivity?` — use that seam). Assert representative `ConnectivityResult` lists map to the correct boolean (e.g. `[wifi]` -> `true`, `[none]` -> `false`). Right now every test that exercises `ChatReady.isOffline` goes through `FakeConnectivityWatcher`, so this file's actual mapping logic — the only adapter wired into the real app via DI — has zero coverage; an inverted comparison there would ship with the full suite green.

8. `lib/features/chat/data/services/connectivity_plus_watcher.dart` — `watch()`'s leading `await _connectivity.checkConnectivity()` has no timeout and runs before the generator ever reaches the live `onConnectivityChanged` subscription. If that platform-channel call hangs instead of throwing, connectivity watching never starts at all for the rest of the session (not just a missed initial snapshot). Restructure so a hang/slow response in that initial read can't block the live subscription from starting (e.g. race it with a short timeout that falls through to subscribing anyway, or start the `onConnectivityChanged` subscription first and treat the initial check as a best-effort seed value only).

Everything else from the review (two new `BlocBuilder`s with no `buildWhen`, the no-`serverId` fallback giving no UI hint it resent as a new message, `isOffline` defaulting false until the first connectivity reading lands, the offline banner not covering the bootstrap-loading/error states) was triaged as defer — I'm logging those to deferred-work.md myself, no action needed from you on those.

Address this before completing your current task.

57	  /// after, both so a long-lived chat session never leaks one live
58	  /// `AnimationController` per past message, and so nothing waiting on
59	  /// "every animation in the tree has settled" (e.g. a test's own
60	  /// `pumpAndSettle()`) ever blocks on a bubble that finished streaming.
61	  void _syncCursorAnimation() {
62	    final shouldAnimate = widget.message.status == ChatMessageStatus.streaming;
63	    if (shouldAnimate && !_cursorController.isAnimating) {
64	      _cursorController.repeat(reverse: true);
65	    } else if (!shouldAnimate && _cursorController.isAnimating) {
66	      _cursorController.stop();
67	    }
68	  }
69	
70	  @override
71	  void dispose() {
72	    _cursorController.dispose();
73	    super.dispose();
74	  }
75	
76	  @override
77	  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
78	    final message = widget.message;
79	    final onRetry = widget.onRetry;
80	    final isUser = message.role == ChatMessageRole.user;
81	    // Boundaries: "cursor skipped under
82	    // `MediaQuery.of(context).disableAnimations`" — the real token text
83	    // itself always reveals as real tokens actually arrive (there is no
84	    // separate typing-speed animation to collapse here), only the
85	    // blinking-cursor glyph is conditional on Reduce Motion.
86	    final reduceMotion = MediaQuery.of(context).disableAnimations;
87	    final showCursor =
88	        message.status == ChatMessageStatus.streaming && !reduceMotion;
89	
90	    // spec-6-3 Boundaries: tap-to-retry copy, tappable, 44pt min tap
91	    // target — replaces the earlier generic (non-tappable) error
92	    // indicator. The visible copy renders identically either way;
93	    // `Semantics(button: true)` only wraps it when [onRetry] is actually
94	    // supplied (review finding) — a bubble built with no retry callback
95	    // must never be announced to a screen reader as a working button.
96	    final retryIndicator = InkWell(
97	      onTap: onRetry,
98	      borderRadius: const BorderRadius.all(
99	        Radius.circular(DesignTokens.radiusSm),
100	      ),
101	      child: ConstrainedBox(
102	        constraints: const BoxConstraints(
103	          minHeight: DesignTokens.insertionModalTapTargetMin,
104	        ),
105	        child: Container(
106	          alignment: Alignment.centerLeft,
107	          padding: DesignTokens.chatFailureIndicatorPadding,
108	          decoration: const BoxDecoration(
109	            color: DesignTokens.colorErrorBg,
110	            borderRadius: BorderRadius.all(
111	              Radius.circular(DesignTokens.radiusSm),
112	            ),
113	          ),
114	          child: Text(
115	            _retryCopy,
116	            style: DesignTokens.textCaptionSm.copyWith(
117	              color: DesignTokens.colorError,
118	            ),
119	          ),
120	        ),
121	      ),
122	    );
123	    final retryIndicatorWithSemantics = onRetry == null
124	        ? retryIndicator
125	        : Semantics(
126	            button: true,
127	            label: _retryCopy,
128	            excludeSemantics: true,
129	            child: retryIndicator,
130	          );
131	
132	    return Align(
133	      alignment: isUser ? Alignment.centerRight : Alignment.centerLeft,
134	      child: Container(
135	        margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: DesignTokens.chatBubbleGap),
136	        constraints: BoxConstraints(
137	          maxWidth:
138	              MediaQuery.of(context).size.width *
139	              DesignTokens.chatBubbleMaxWidthFraction,
140	        ),
141	        padding: DesignTokens.chatBubblePadding,
142	        decoration: BoxDecoration(
143	          color: isUser
144	              ? DesignTokens.colorChatBubbleUser
145	              : DesignTokens.colorSurfaceElevated,
146	          borderRadius: BorderRadius.only(
147	            topLeft: const Radius.circular(DesignTokens.radiusMd),
148	            topRight: const Radius.circular(DesignTokens.radiusMd),
149	            bottomLeft: Radius.circular(isUser ? DesignTokens.radiusMd : 0),
150	            bottomRight: Radius.circular(isUser ? 0 : DesignTokens.radiusMd),
151	          ),
152	          boxShadow: isUser ? null : DesignTokens.elevation1,
153	        ),
154	        child: Column(
155	          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
156	          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
157	          children: [
158	            Text.rich(
159	              TextSpan(
160	                children: [
161	                  TextSpan(text: message.content),
162	                  if (showCursor)
163	                    WidgetSpan(
164	                      alignment: PlaceholderAlignment.middle,
165	                      child: ExcludeSemantics(

169	                        ),

input.message:
All 8 review findings patched. `fvm flutter analyze` → zero issues. `fvm flutter test` → 961 passed, 0 failed (was 954 before this round; +7 new tests from findings 6 and 7).

1. **`chat_cubit.dart` — offline guard on `sendMessage`/`retryMessage`:** both now early-return on `current.isOffline`, alongside the existing `current is! ChatReady`/`_isSending` guards. A retry tap on an old failed bubble can no longer fire a real network call while the offline banner is showing.

2. **`chat_bubble.dart` — `Semantics(button: true)` gated on `onRetry != null`:** restructured so the plain visible retry copy is always built, but only wrapped in `Semantics(button: true, label: ...)` when a callback was actually supplied; otherwise it falls through to the `Text`'s own default (non-button) semantics.

3. **`chat_cubit.dart` — `retryMessage` role check:** the guard now also requires `messages[aiIndex].role == ChatMessageRole.assistant` alongside the existing `status == failed` check, matching the surrounding defensive style.

4. **`chat_bubble.dart` — deduped retry copy:** extracted to a top-level `const _retryCopy` string, referenced by both the `Semantics.label` and the visible `Text`.

5. **`pubspec.yaml` — comment added** above `connectivity_plus` explaining it backs the feature-local `ConnectivityWatcher`/`ConnectivityPlusWatcher` for spec-6-3. (Also found and fixed a pre-existing duplicate `connectivity_plus:` mapping key in the file — introduced by `pub add` placing one copy while I was separately adding the commented one — which was breaking YAML parsing.)

6. **New widget test — normal retry path:** added to `chat_screen_test.dart`, driven through a real mounted `ChatScreen`/`ChatBubble` tap: sends a message, delivers `ChatMessageCreatedEvent` (capturing `serverId`) then a mid-stream drop, taps the rendered retry copy, and asserts `retryMessageCalls == ['srv-user-1']` with `sendMessageCalls` staying at `['oi']` (no fallback), then drives the retry stream to `complete` and checks the bubble id never changed. The fake repository's `retryMessage` also now returns a controllable `StreamController` (previously `Stream.empty()`) so this and future tests can drive it.

7. **New unit test file — `test/features/chat/data/services/connectivity_plus_watcher_test.dart`:** mocks `Connectivity` directly via its injectable constructor seam (mirrors `record_mic_recorder_test.dart`'s convention). Covers the `_isOnline` mapping (`wifi`→true, `none`→false, live event mapping) and, since finding 8 touched this file's logic directly, the new ordering/hang-safety behavior too (6 tests total).

8. **`connectivity_plus_watcher.dart` restructured:** `watch()` now starts the live `onConnectivityChanged` subscription immediately and synchronously; the `checkConnectivity()` initial read runs as a fire-and-forget, independent seed that only lands if it resolves before any live event already has, wrapped in its own try/catch (not just relying on `Future.then`'s error channel, since a mocked/misbehaving call could throw synchronously). A hang or slow response on the initial check can no longer delay, let alone block, live connectivity watching.

No spec changes, no reverts — all 8 were additive/corrective patches as instructed. Files touched this round: `lib/features/chat/presentation/cubit/chat_cubit.dart`, `lib/features/chat/presentation/widgets/chat_bubble.dart`, `lib/features/chat/data/services/connectivity_plus_watcher.dart`, `pubspec.yaml`, `test/features/chat/presentation/screens/chat_screen_test.dart`, and the new `test/features/chat/data/services/connectivity_plus_watcher_test.dart`.
